original_finding_content.subject: Chargeback warning review (Trustpilot) — ambiguous URL and secondhand experience
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** Reviewer describes cousin's ("primo") experience as top-selling producer with 100,000+ affiliates whose accounts were repeatedly blocked due to chargeback ratios at scale.  
**Verbatim snippet:** "Mi primo ha creado productos en hotmart y ha logrado obtener cientos de miles de afiliados. Logró tener muchas ventas de manera diaria pero obtuvo muchos chargeback mientras incrementaba sus ventas... Ya varias cuentas se le bloqueó a mi primo, y todos fueron por chargeback. Asi que tengan cuidado productores."  
**Source:** https://es.trustpilot.com/review/hotmart.com (exact page uncertain)  
**source_type:** buyer_review  
**Notes:** Two disqualifiers: (1) Ambiguous URL — exact Trustpilot page could not be fixed (appeared in search results and across multiple cached page versions). Per rule 9: ambiguous URL → Part 4. (2) Secondhand experience — the seller experiences described are attributed to the reviewer's cousin, not the reviewer themselves. Speaker's own seller status not established.
